Dinner with a Mughal view

Cooco's Den is a rooftop restaurant on Fort Road Food Street, by the historic Roshnai Gate in Lahore. Its open-air terrace looks straight across at the Badshahi Mosque — one of the most recognisable dining views in the city.

The kitchen is classic desi: karahis cooked to order, chicken tikka and BBQ straight off the coals. Mornings start early with breakfast service, and on Sundays the rooftop hosts a brunch that draws families from across Lahore.

With a 3.8-star Google rating across more than 3,000 reviews and a Tripadvisor ranking of #20 out of 643 restaurants in Lahore, it remains one of Food Street's best-known rooftops.

Specialities

The dishes the rooftop is known for — cooked fresh, served hot, best eaten with the mosque lit up across the street.

Karahi

The house favourite — chicken karahi wok-cooked with tomatoes, green chillies, ginger and fresh coriander, mopped up with hot naan.
